iterations.plan: Parse the rolls into frames (handling the special 10th frame rule), calculate the score for each frame considering strikes and spares with their bonuses, being careful not to look beyond available rolls.

def house_bowling(rolls: list[int]) -> int:
    score = 0
    roll_idx = 0
    
    for frame_num in range(10):
        if frame_num < 9:  # Frames 1-9
            if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike
                score += 10
                # Add next two rolls as bonus
                if roll_idx + 1 < len(rolls):
                    score += rolls[roll_idx + 1]
                if roll_idx + 2 < len(rolls):
                    score += rolls[roll_idx + 2]
                roll_idx += 1
            elif rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1] == 10:  # Spare
                score += 10
                # Add next roll as bonus
                if roll_idx + 2 < len(rolls):
                    score += rolls[roll_idx + 2]
                roll_idx += 2
            else:  # Open frame
                score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
                roll_idx += 2
        else:  # Frame 10 (special rule: no extra rolls)
            # In frame 10, just add all remaining rolls with no bonuses
            if roll_idx < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[roll_idx]
                roll_idx += 1
            if roll_idx < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[roll_idx]
                roll_idx += 1
    
    return score
